related_questions.question: When is COVID most contagious?
related_questions.snippet: “A big study came out in the fall of 2023 which showed that most people are the most contagious on day four of symptoms with COVID and then it wanes from there,” said Dr. Roberts. While people become less contagious over time, they are still contagious with COVID for an average of eight days.

related_questions.question: Can you live with someone with COVID and not get it?
related_questions.snippet: Because coronavirus is transmitted through close contact with someone who is infected, it's common for the virus to spread within homes. But a positive diagnosis for one person doesn't always mean others will be infected.
related_questions.title: Someone In Your Household Has COVID-19 Here's What You Can Do

related_questions.question: Can you beat COVID in 3 days?

text_blocks.snippet: No, it's not generally possible to "beat" COVID-19 in 3 days. Most people with mild to moderate cases of COVID-19 take between one and two weeks to recover, according to UnityPoint Health and WebMD. The time it takes to recover can vary depending on individual factors like age, overall health, and the severity of the initial infection. The CDC recommends isolation until symptoms are improving and you are fever-free for 24 hours without medication.
